SELECT FROM auth_governance.request_policy p WHERE AND enabled AND id > #{after} AND approver_membership_id <> #{member} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.membership m WHERE m.id=p.approver_membership_id AND m.generation=p.approver_generation AND m.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND state IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW') AND valid_to > clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: WITH expired AS (SELECT o.request_id FROM auth_governance.request_start_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND o.state='RUNNING' AND o.attempts=5 AND o.lease_until < clock_timestamp() ORDER BY o.request_id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox o SET state='DEAD',last_error='OA_START_UNCONFIRMED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM expired e WHERE o.request_id=e.request_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.audit_event(id,operator_ref,tenant_id,operation,target_id,target_version,command_id) SELECT #{audit},'OA_START_WORKER',tenant_id,'OA_START_BOUND',id,state_version,#{lease} FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT o.request_id FROM auth_governance.request_start_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND o.attempts < 5 AND o.next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (o.state='PENDING' OR (o.state='RUNNING' AND o.lease_until < clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY o.next_attempt_at,o.request_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox o SET state='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{lease}, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM candidate c WHERE o.request_id=c.request_id RETURNING o.request_id
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox SET state='DONE',lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts=5 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, lease_until=NULL,last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>power(2,attempts)::int),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE auth_governance.access_request SET approval_instance_id=#{instance}, state=CASE WHEN state='SUBMITTED' THEN 'IN_REVIEW' ELSE state END,state_version=state_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND (approval_instance_id IS NULL OR approval_instance_id=#{instance})
